# GDAL test files

`smalltest.dgn` and `assorted.dxf` are copied unchanged from the GDAL/OGR
autotest suite (https://github.com/OSGeo/gdal, `autotest/ogr/data/`). The
expected values in `tests/web/cad-dgn7.test.mjs` and `tests/web/cad-dxf.test.mjs`
come from GDAL's own tests for these files (`autotest/ogr/ogr_dgn.py`,
`autotest/ogr/ogr_dxf.py`).
